Estimated contents: one slice of raisin toast (about 90 kcal), roughly half an avocado sliced (about 120 kcal), one poached or fried egg (about 75 kcal), and a small espresso-style coffee with milk (about 15 kcal). That gives about 300 kcal served.

I can't tell from a before-eating photo how much will be left, so I assumed little or none, with a small allowance of about 10 kcal for leftover toast crust or similar.

Macros for the portion eaten, about 290 kcal in total:
- Protein: toast 3 g, egg 6 g, avocado 1.5 g, coffee 1 g, so about 11 g.
- Carbohydrate: toast 17 g, avocado 6 g, coffee 1.5 g, so about 25 g.
- Fat: avocado 11 g, egg 5 g, toast 1 g, so about 17 g.
